title: The Song of the Vineyard

questions.question: My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:1 (ESV): "My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile hill."

questions.question: He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded what?
And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge between me and my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:3 (ESV): "judge between me and my vineyard."

questions.question: Woe to those who call evil good and good what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:20 (ESV): "Woe to those who call evil good and good evil,"

questions.question: Woe to those who are wise in their own what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:21 (ESV): "Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes,"

questions.question: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:7 (ESV): "For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel,"

questions.question: He looked for justice, but behold, bloodshed; for righteousness, but behold, an what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:7 (ESV): "for righteousness, but behold, an outcry!"

questions.question: Woe to those who join house to house, who add field to field, until there is no more what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:8 (ESV): "until there is no more room,"

questions.question: My people go into exile for lack of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:13 (ESV): "Therefore my people go into exile for lack of knowledge;"

questions.question: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its appetite and opened its mouth beyond what?
I will remove its hedge, and it shall be devoured; I will break down its wall, and it shall be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:5 (ESV): "and it shall be trampled down."

questions.question: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, who draw sin as with what ropes?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:18 (ESV): "who draw sin as with cart ropes,"

questions.question: Who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:20 (ESV): "who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!"

questions.question: For they have rejected the law of the LORD of hosts, and have despised the word of the Holy One of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:24 (ESV): "and have despised the word of the Holy One of Israel."

questions.question: In that day they will roar together like young what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 5:29 (ESV): "Their roaring is like a lion, like young lions they roar;"

key_verse_text: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!
